Eligibility Criteria
Users must meet one of the following conditions based on the snapshot taken on April 15, 2022:
$300 tier
: Wallets that completed more than one transaction before the snapshot.
$1,000 tier
: Wallets that held a
Genie:Genesis NFT
as of the snapshot.
Users who purchased a
Genie:Genesis NFT
or
Genie:Gem NFT
between
5:59 pm and 9:15 pm UTC on June 21, 2022
, are also eligible.
Eligibility is per unique wallet address (multiple NFTs in the same wallet do not increase allocation).
Users must claim their airdrop in
USDC
on
Uniswap
by connecting their wallet.
